styleLock.direction: soft premium skincare commerce with a gel-texture hero language
styleLock.backgroundSystem: one flat field per shot inside the blush-cream family: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft blush #F7E6E4 and warm cream #F3EDE6 for info and scene screens, rose #EFD9D6 for comparison panels
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight studio light, broad front key with gentle fill, skimming side light for gel texture, soft contact shadows, never harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte warm pedestal and counter surfaces in cream #F3EDE6 and blush #F7E6E4, wet translucent gel domes as the recurring material note
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for label slots only, hairline rules and rounded pill tags, every claim carried as a placeholder slot
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and hollow seal frames in the accent rose #D99A93, no filled pictograms
styleLock.presentationRules: pouch stays upright at a stable slight 3/4 scale across the set; gel sheet always shows its cut eye, nose and mouth slits and its edge thickness; skin is cropped at cheek, jaw or collarbone so no identity remains
noDrift: no ranking, review or sold-count badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium soft-lens skincare commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, soft blush field #F7E6E4, dusty rose accent #D99A93 and warm charcoal text #3A3232; neutral bright studio lighting with a broad front key, gentle fill and skimming side light for gel texture, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; one flat background field per shot inside the blush-cream family; modern geometric sans-serif label slots with hairline rules and rounded pill tags; thin single-weight line icons and hollow seal frames only; gel surfaces read wet, translucent and lightly glossy with visible edge thickness; stable slight 3/4 product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no ranking or review badges.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用袋装与厚膜布的组合同时讲清剂型和用量形态。

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, broad front key with a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows under each item
shots.props: none beyond the pack itself and one unfolded gel sheet
shots.whitespace: none, the silhouette fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The pouch standing upright with one unfolded face-shaped gel sheet curling in front of it and its carton behind, straight-on eye-level view, full group visible and not clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a broad front key and a fill card on the shadow side, soft contact shadows grounding every item. Seamless clean white background #FFFFFF. The group occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace around the silhouette. 8K commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no brand wordmark, no weight or sheet-count numerals, no hands, no props beyond the pack, no on-image text, no watermark, no fake logo, no gel sheet floating without a contact shadow.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 白底袋装＋厚凝胶膜布＋纸盒组合；02 粉调场域台座阶梯陈列＋两枚圆形印章角标与榜单脚注；03 粉调场域＋悬浮凝胶珠＋浮动袋装＋同框双栏肤面虚线圈注对照；04 左文列右凝胶珠群＋三枚胶囊标签位；05 同人脸左右两态（乳白厚膜布→透明薄膜）加箭头与底部状态色条；06 人物肩颈手持撕袋＋左下四行勾选文字；07 米白场域四栏选款表（袋＋盒＋色块＋三行话题标签＋一枚星形角标）。品类判定：以图为准，主体为贴膜式水凝胶面膜，属护肤个护/面部护理（护理类，非着色彩妆，故不入美妆彩妆）；源类目路径仅作参考线索，未采信其字样。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列名、原平台榜单与销量角标、星级与社会证明字样、全部原文案原句、净含量与片数等数值、分子量与成分名等参数、模特面容身份（全部改为颈下或颊颌裁切）、膜布变透的机理表述（仅保留左右两态的视觉结构）。功效位一律改为空白勾选行、空胶囊标签与空印章框占位。
